svg.title: August 2005: The missed payment, the debt authorization and Katrina
svg.desc: An original Final Vestige Studios chronological evidence chart. A federal district court's 2007 order reported a missed class settlement installment on August 15, 2005; the levee district's audited financial statements report August 17 authorization of up to 11.2 million dollars in proposed debt to settle Bohemia litigation; Hurricane Katrina made landfall August 29. Chronology does not prove the financing authorization responded to the missed installment or that any funds were paid.
svg.metadata: Creator: Final Vestige Studios Research/Investigations. Created 2026-11-16. Copyright 2026 Final Vestige Studios; original editorial vector diagram, all original typesetting and shapes, no documentary photograph or AI reconstruction. Evidence 1: US District Court EDLA 06-3829 Document 154 filed 2007-02-28 https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/USCOURTS-laed-2_06-cv-03829/pdf/USCOURTS-laed-2_06-cv-03829-1.pdf ; evidence 2: Louisiana Legislative Auditor Orleans Levee District FY2005 audited statements Note 23 printed p.69 https://app.lla.la.gov/publicreports.nsf/0/88e334f6ae3ae3e5862570a60069ba83/$file/0000104f.pdf and FY2006 Note17 printed p54 https://app.lla.la.gov/publicreports.nsf/0/f190284f7da564b88625725e0078912f/$file/000008c0.pdf ; evidence 3: NWS Katrina anniversary https://www.weather.gov/lix/katrina_anniversary . Editorial diagram, not a historical artifact or evidence of payment; no embedded external assets.
svg.text: Three dated records. No assumed cause.
Later described in a federal court order.
Up to $11.2m authorized for Bohemia litigation.
Source: Orleans Levee District FY2005 audit, p. 69
Sources: NWS; FY2005 and FY2006 audit notes
The board vote does not prove a loan was issued,
why the installment failed, or that heirs were paid.
FVS / Original source-based editorial diagram / 16 Nov 2026
